positions.name: ErasureDirectivePair
positions.frame: Are these two forget/remove commands one continuous instruction to purge a linked body of knowledge (fleet, contracts, routes), or separate discrete requests that happen to sit in the same message?
positions.why: Both segments are imperative erasure directives from the same speaker in the same envelope, sharing a parallel formula ('Forget everything about' / 'Remove all knowledge of') that the style read flags as a recurring directive pattern rather than incidental phrasing. The affect, power, relational, and conviction reads land identically on both — calm-negative register, authority-ranking/coercive stance, settled decision-grade commitment with no hedging — so the two directives cohere as one continuous erasure instruction spanning fleet/contract and route knowledge, even though the referenced subject matter itself is new to this perspective and unbound to any existing node.
